posts.text: I was trying to make my personal website more personal but it got a little out of hand. i cloned myself. there's now an AI version of me floating on around my website. he talks like me, and he flies around and points at things you ask about. his brain is a mini version of my obsidian vault. a script reads my notes, condenses each one, and syncs them to the site. talking to him used to feel like texting a slow texter, so i split the work in two. a fast model reads your message in about 100 ms, fi
